agreement: The August strikes reached far beyond the border strip, which supports an escalating trend.
disagreement: Some experts see the strikes as episodic and doubt they will become sustained across several border localities within six months.
Late September was quiet inside Chad; current pressure comes mainly from refugee arrivals.
newInformation: Trigger T0618 still shows 40%, set in June, although the August strikes went deep into Ennedi-Est.
items.draft: Experts broadly agree that the conflict reached further into Chad in August, notably with the convoy strike more than 100 km inside Ennedi-Est. They are split on whether attacks will become sustained and recurrent: two see episodic incidents and point to a quieter late September. One expert notes that trigger T0618 has not been updated since June. Suggested action: review T0618's completion rate.
